india.one_line: India signs a global AI supply chain declaration, Oister Global launches a deeptech fund, and Meta modifies Instagram recommendations.

themes.title: India signs AI supply chain declaration
themes.text: India and nine other nations signed the San Francisco Declaration on November 15 to protect AI infrastructure and sensitive technologies.

stories.headline: India and nine nations sign declaration to safeguard AI supply chains

themes.title: Oister Global launches deeptech fund
themes.text: Oister Global launched a ₹600 crore growth-stage deeptech fund to support 8 to 10 revenue-generating Indian startups in sectors like space and semiconductors.

stories.headline: Oister Global launches ₹600 Cr growth-stage deeptech fund

themes.title: Meta modifies Instagram recommendations in India
themes.text: Following regulatory scrutiny, Meta updated Instagram's AI-driven recommendation systems in India to limit violent and sexually suggestive content from unfollowed accounts.

stories.headline: Meta modifies Instagram recommendation systems in India to curb violent content
